intro: Lazur is an AI assistant for Excel on your Mac: hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask where a feature is or what a formula does. It sees your sheet, circles the right button and walks you through the steps.
tldr: Ask “where's conditional formatting?” and Lazur circles it on the ribbon.
Select a formula and ask “what does this do?”. Lazur explains it out loud.
Ask “walk me through a pivot table” and it guides you one click at a time.
Lazur does not change your workbook. You stay in control of every click.

blocks.text: Excel on a Mac is not Excel on Windows

Most Excel tutorials are recorded on Windows. The ribbon looks similar, but shortcuts use ⌘ instead of Ctrl, and some dialogs sit in different places. Lazur sees the Mac version you actually have open, so the answer matches your screen.
Start with [how to make a pivot table in Excel on Mac](/how-to/make-a-pivot-table-in-excel). Every guide lists the menu path, the shortcut and what to do when it does not work.

faq.question: Is Lazur an Excel add-in?
faq.answer: No. Nothing is installed in Excel. Lazur runs on your Mac and looks at the screen only while you hold ⌥ ⌘.

faq.question: Can Lazur do the Excel work for me?
faq.answer: It does not click inside Excel or edit your file. It explains, points at buttons and walks you through each step.

faq.question: Does it work with Numbers and Google Sheets?
faq.answer: Yes. It works on top of any Mac app, including Numbers and Google Sheets in the browser.
